course_name_original: Fundamentos de tecnología electrónica y automática
course_name_en: Fundamentals of Electronic and Automatic Technology

learning_outcomes.text: Knows the fundamentals of electronics. Knows the fundamentals of automatisms and control methods.
Knows the fundamentals of analog and digital electronics. Understands the characteristics of digital processors, their operation, and applications.
Knows the characteristics and applications of sensors and control elements.

syllabus_topics: SEMICONDUCTORS. Electrical properties of Ge and Si. Thermistors. VDR and LDR. Junction diodes.
DIODE CIRCUITS. Rectifier circuits. Meters with rectification. Voltage multipliers. Power supplies.
BJT, JFET AND MOSFET TRANSISTORS. Characteristics. Models. Basic amplifiers. Switches. Power amplifiers.
OPERATIONAL AMPLIFIERS. Differential amplifiers. Instrumentation amplifiers. Basic circuits.
BASIC NOTIONS OF DIGITAL ELECTRONICS. Combinational circuits. Sequential circuits. Processors.
FEEDBACK CONTROL SYSTEMS. Negative feedback. Positive feedback. Oscillators. P Controllers. PD Controllers. PID Controllers.
DIGITAL AND ANALOG INSTRUMENTATION AND CONTROL. Sensors. Measurement instruments. Control circuits.
COMMUNICATION SYSTEMS IN INDUSTRY. Telemetry. Remote control and teleoperation. Telecommunications.
teaching_methods: Introductory activities: Introduce the contents of electronics.
Lectures: Develop the contents of the different topics of the course.
Problem/exercise solving in the ordinary classroom: Problem solving.
Presentations/expositions: Presentation of different systems that help in the understanding of electronics.
Personalized attention: Clarification of doubts on any topic of the course.

assessment_methods.method: Mixed tests: 1.- ANALOG ELECTRONICS ELEMENTS AND SYSTEMS. These tests will consist of theoretical multiple-choice questions and problem-solving related to the corresponding content.
Mixed tests: 2.- DIGITAL ELECTRONICS ELEMENTS AND SYSTEMS. These tests will consist of theoretical multiple-choice questions and problem-solving related to the corresponding content.
Other: During the course, small voluntary tests and problems will be presented that can improve the final grade obtained.

assessment_rules: The final grade will be the average of the two partial tests performed, and it is not necessary for both tests to be passed to pass the course in the first call. Students who do not pass the course in the first call will have a second call in a single global exam. During the evaluation tests, only electronic equipment and documents authorized by the professor may be used. Fraudulent performance of any evaluative activity using any means will result in a failing grade for that activity for the student, and, depending on the severity of the facts, may lead to disciplinary action.
